request.question: What did people actually pay for Post Alley, per copy?

reply: The terminal has no average price per copy, so I can't show what people paid for each copy of Post Alley. I can show its revenue, which is what was paid after discounts, and its units, each on its own. I can also show its list price by edition, which is the price before any discount.
